question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **and.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **And** is a coordinating conjunction, that is used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

 
 
• **Example -** *Bread **and** Butter*
 
 
 
• ​Here, in the given paragraph **'and'** is used to join the clauses **"She went to her work corner in the living room****", "looked at the notes she had pinned up on the wall..."**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'and'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Salander sat for a while **__(1) holding__** the telephone after Armansky hung up. She went to her work corner in the living room **(2) **__**and**__ looked at the notes she had pinned up on the wall and the papers she had (3) ______ on the desk. What she had managed to collect was mostly press cuttings and articles (4) ______ from the Internet. She took the papers and dropped (5) ______ in a desk drawer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **So **is used as subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of result or decision. 
 
• **But **used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned.
 
• **Although** means in spite of the fact that; even though.
